verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail explicitly offers check deposit as a core feature (no need to visit the bank, batch deposits for savings), directly matching the founder story of hands-off check handling. However, evidence doesn't confirm the service performs endorsement or reconciliation into the founder's own bank account as an automated end-to-end pipeline — details are limited to marketing copy. Missing for 10: documentation on endorsement handling, deposit confirmation/reconciliation workflow, and independent/hands-on verification of the deposit process working as described.
